title: SchoolDesk Enterprise Keycloak Roles & Permissions Catalog
description: Comprehensive role-based access control (RBAC) and fine-grained permission catalog ready for Keycloak realm import and FastAPI authorization enforcement. NOTE: each role carries a 'phase' field. Only phase 1 roles are active and supported; phase 2 roles are planned and must not be built on. See .agents/AGENTS.md section 4 for the real state of each phase 2 role in the codebase.

phases.2: Planned, NOT in scope. May be partially scaffolded in code, but scaffolding is not a working feature.

composite_roles.name: super_admin
composite_roles.description: Global Platform Super Administrator with unrestricted access across all school tenants.

composite_roles.name: school_admin
composite_roles.description: School Tenant Administrator managing school structure, staff invitations, and publishing policies.

composite_roles.name: manager
composite_roles.description: School Operations & Event Review Manager responsible for approving event proposals and budgets.

composite_roles.name: teacher
composite_roles.description: Class Teacher / Trip Organizer capable of creating events, requesting resources, and managing student rosters.

composite_roles.name: event_teacher
composite_roles.description: Assigned Event Head Teacher with temporary elevated editing rights for a specific trip.

composite_roles.name: finance
composite_roles.description: School Financial Officer in charge of unit pricing, subsidy calculations, invoicing, and refunds.

composite_roles.name: parent
composite_roles.description: Parent / Guardian capable of viewing published trips, approving child enrollments, and paying trip fees.

composite_roles.name: student
composite_roles.description: Enrolled Student able to browse published trips, submit enrollment requests, and leave feedback.

composite_roles.name: school_nurse
composite_roles.description: School Medical / Health Staff managing student medical records and trip safety plans.

composite_roles.name: auditor
composite_roles.description: Read-Only Compliance & Financial Auditor for legal and regulatory verification.
